_comment: Claude Code hooks for hippo-pipeline. These fire ONLY in Claude Code CLI
sessions (the `claude` command in a terminal). They do NOT run in Cowork,
claude.ai, or any other interface - see GENERAL_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md 5.
In those interfaces the same checks are available as `make lint` and `make test`,
Hook 1: architectural constraint lint  (playbook Pattern 1, enforces ADR-003)
Hook 2: auto-run the matching unit test (playbook Pattern 2)

hooks.command: python3 scripts/hooks/filepath.py | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/hippo_pipeline/*.py) bash scripts/lint_architecture.sh "$f" ;; esac; }

python3 scripts/hooks/filepath.py | { read -r f; base="$(basename "$f" .py)"; case "$f" in */src/hippo_pipeline/*.py) if [ "$base" != "__init__" ] && [ -f "tests/unit/test_${base}.py" ]; then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run pytest "tests/unit/test_${base}.py" -q; else python3 -m pytest "tests/unit/test_${base}.py" -q; fi; else echo "NO UNIT TEST for ${base} - tests/unit/test_${base}.py is missing"; fi ;; esac; }
python3 scripts/hooks/filepath.py | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.yml|*.yaml|*.json) bash scripts/validate_config.sh "$f" ;; esac; }
python3 scripts/hooks/filepath.py | { read -r f; case "$f" in */Makefile|Makefile|*/README.md|README.md) bash scripts/check_docs_commands.sh ;; esac; }
